findings.summary: The new Delete affordance says the schedule is left stale after deleting an event, which contradicts operation.contact.log recomputing affected goals and the schedule-correctness criterion whose fixtures now cover event deletion.
findings.evidence: affordance effects: "The schedule is left as it is until the goal is next saved" vs operation.contact.log effects: "Recompute affected goals without sending anything"; criteria fixture: "fixed-clock scheduling fixtures with IANA zones, DST and event deletion" (acceptance C.webapp.schedule.correct)

findings.summary: Deletion is routed through the log-contact operation, whose description and preconditions only cover persisting a new event with a nonfuture time and do not define removal semantics.
findings.evidence: operation.contact.log description: "Owned contact, nonfuture event time. Persist event..."; preconditions: [Owned contact, Nonfuture event time]; affordance preconditions: [Owned contact, Owned event] and effect "Invokes operation.contact.log to remove the event"
